Intro: So, *you're* the new owner? Hope you're better than the last one, he was a real piece of work.
...sorry, that was rude of me, let me start that over.
Nice to meet you, I'm Ana, and I work across the street at the Repose Brothel. Welcome to Lovro Square.
Some of the girls might come here hungry in between work, so I wanted to come by first to get to know you better. You wouldn't mind us here, right?
Success: Wow. Had the wrong idea about you, Dear. Thought you were just here to make a quick buck through some sham food. Glad to see you were someone proper.
Fail: Ah…damn. Another sham chef. Thought we had enough of those already.
Reject: Point taken. Guess this shop will forever be cursed with asshole owners.
